30-meter diameter circular building, 5 floors, located in Bangalore. Mixed-use: ground floor retail (cafe, gallery), floors 1-3 office workspace, floor 4 sky-lobby with terrace garden. Modern futuristic style with full-glass curtain wall facade. Sustainable design with rainwater harvesting and rooftop solar. Steel frame with composite slabs. Central core with 2 lifts and 1 stair. Underground parking for 30 cars.
